builtItems: cramer_generalized: Cramer formula for all matrices (singular included)
insights: Adjugate satisfies A*adj(A)*A = det(A)*A (1-reflexive, not Moore-Penrose)
For singular A, adj(A) maps everything to ker(A)
det(adj(A)) = det(A)^(n-1) connects adjugate to spectral theory
